additional_info.subject: ID0477679-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Cable temp sensor error CRM:03275000059
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477679
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
CHR-01
Charger ID / Serial No.:
93MxOS
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Cable temp sensor error.
Following the customer report and after our check , we have confirmed that the Temperature Sensor is faulty.Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF212/214
.
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm until the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: Plan next onsite intervention
additional_info.body:
We performed an onsite intervention at 22/01/2026 due to issue quality issue reported in the ISP ticket 0449204.
After the replacement, it appears sensor temperature issue.
We are going to replace the StateMonitor.

Hi,
Today I was on site for another activity but I was able to verify the error on the charger.
After checking the wires related to the CCS cable, I found a wiring error that prevented the PT1000 from working.
After rewiring correctly, the charger socket is now operational again.
Thanks a lot
Have a nice evening,
Giuseppe
